sections.text_helper: Section 28.7.18 "XSPI low-power timeout register (XSPI_LPTR)" in chapter 28 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1342.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x130
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be modified only when BUSY = 0.
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 TIMEOUT[15:0]: Timeout period
After each access in memory-mapped mode, the XSPI prefetches the subsequent bytes and
hold them in the FIFO.
This bitfield indicates how many CLK cycles the XSPI waits after the clock becomes inactive
and until it raises the NCS, putting the external device in a lower-consumption state.
